info.title: Hyperpax Spot API
info.description: REST API for Hyperpax the Flagship trading platform of Paxeer Network.

get.description: PAXSCAN identity (first/last seen, txCount, gas, contracts deployed, native PAX balance) merged with our derived trading stats (lifetime trade count, USD volume, PoFQ, 24h slice) and the most recent PnL snapshot.

get.summary: Open or historical positions joined with live PAXSCAN balance
get.description: Our derived weighted-average-cost positions joined with the live PAXSCAN ERC-20 balance per token. Surfaces `externalActivity:true` when the on-chain balance differs from the qty we attributed via trade events.
